description:
ABOUT BRACKET BOT

Robots today are where computers were when they filled a room: expensive, hard to use, and run by specialists.

 

We’re making the one anyone can afford. That means designing all of it ourselves: the parts, the boards, the connectors, the software and the ML.

 

Then we put our robots to work in the real world to learn what they need next.

 

We’re backed by Fifty Years (Scott Phoenix), BoxGroup, SV Angel, Betaworks, Pace Capital, and angels including Nat Friedman, Logan Kilpatrick (Google AI), Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and others from Tesla AI, Physical Intelligence, and Markforged.

 
 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Machine learning should give robots useful capabilities that hold up beyond a single demonstration.

 

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Research Engineer to develop, evaluate, and integrate models for physical robots. You’ll work across research experiments, data, model evaluation, and inference to turn promising ideas into working robot behavior.

 

You’ll collaborate with robotics and software engineers, test on real hardware, and use observed failures to guide the next experiment.

 
 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Develop and evaluate machine learning approaches for robot perception and behavior.

 - Build data and evaluation workflows that make model performance and failure modes clear.

 - Run experiments, compare approaches, and communicate results and tradeoffs.

 - Integrate models into robot software and test them on physical hardware.

 - Improve inference performance and reliability within practical compute and latency constraints.

 - Work with robotics and software engineers to turn research results into useful product capabilities.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong machine learning fundamentals and practical research engineering skills.

 - Experience implementing, training, or evaluating models.

 - Ability to design useful experiments and reason carefully about results.

 - Strong programming skills and comfort working across research and production code.

 - Interest in physical robots and willingness to test ideas against real-world behavior.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with robotics learning, computer vision, multimodal models, or control.

 - Experience with simulation, robot datasets, or real-world evaluation.

 - Experience optimizing inference on constrained hardware.

 - Open-source work, research projects, or shipped ML systems that demonstrate your approach.

 


IMPORTANT NOTES

 - The role combines research with implementation and testing on robots.

 - We value clear experiments, honest evaluation, and capabilities that work in practice.

 - You’ll help shape how machine learning becomes part of the product.

 


HOW TO APPLY

Apply at bracketbot.com/apply https://bracketbot.com/apply. It takes a name or a link and about ten seconds: no resume, no form. One application covers every role, and we match you to one during interviews. The Apply button on this page works too.

 

The process is a 15-minute call, a review of your past work, then a work trial of two to five days with us in San Francisco. The job is onsite here, but you don’t need to live here yet.

 

Bracket Bot is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a diverse team and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
